identity: instrumented copy reproduces frozen counters exactly (see g1_duud parity and g4 parity)
caveat: Absolute ms come from the instrumented run: per-call timers and expansion bookkeeping roughly triple wall time (overheadRatio). SHARES are directional; the microbench section gives overhead-free per-call costs measured outside the solve on 131 sampled expansion states.

generationSplitFromLLLD.note: profileGen re-implementation passed 400/400 signature checks against the real generator.

answers.whereTimeGoes: Generation of legal actions and their successors dominates (~55% of instrumented self time), with stateKey construction second (~26%) and hash-map memo operations third (~5–6%). CHANCE recursion itself is counted as subtree walk, not as generation.
answers.chanceNote: CHANCE makes the tree wide (DUUD: 2,122 chance transitions → 53,766 outcomes), so successors are generated/visited many times while the PARENT action lists are almost never regenerated (0.2% repeat keys).
